meta.sign_convention: delta_s = target elapsed time − reference elapsed time at the same distance. Positive = the target is behind (has lost time); negative = the target is ahead. delta_s[0] is 0 and delta_s[-1] equals the official lap-time gap (target − reference) within 0.02 s.

notes: traffic data unavailable: do not attribute time loss to traffic
